supportStory: Customer came with TL-WR845N router. Customer said router works very slow. I scanned SN from backside sticker and checked warranty portal. Router was out of warranty but router support is free. I asked if ONU and adapter were checked. ISP already checked and said router issue. I powered router on. Power light and WAN blinking were normal. I inserted WAN and LAN cable. I reset router by pressing reset hole for 5 seconds. I opened router IP 192.168.0.1 in browser after setting PC IP in same series. I created new login password twice. Then I opened System Tools firmware update and uploaded firmware bin file for TL-WR845N Ver 4 US. Update took 2-3 minutes and router rebooted. Then I configured Quick Setup with location and ISP type dynamic or PPPoE and SSID and password. Issue solved.
